title: Safe Zones
subtitle: A route is only useful if you can return
summary: Safe zones anchor Ashfall exploration. They provide return points, weather shelter, reward claim timing, and route planning context.
body: Before chasing a POI marker, make sure the route has a known return point. Weather, hunger, and exposure all make retreat planning part of progression.
The starter shelter and early outposts should remain visually distinct from hazard and faction markers.
If a route sends the player into a hazard without a safe-zone fallback, treat it as a blocker for manual smoke.
